title: Matassa's hedonistic years and not drinking
summary: Matassa jokes about being a nondrinking Italian who enjoyed life and food, and had only one vice.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, I, I mean, I invested too much in the, the music and the people and the food and, and I didn't drink. So, you know, I was kind of a, a strange member of some of these groups, you know. I, I, I wasn't the designated driver. It was just that I didn't drink. And, and, uh, you know, there were a few places where, where I embarrassed bartenders by, by ordering Coke. They said, they'd, they'd give me Coke with a slice of orange or a cherry in it or something. You're going to stink up the place here drinking Coke, you know. You know, and that kind of stuff. But, uh.

Yeah. It was a real anomaly, you know. I, I, I remember telling a guy once, I said, I, I, I, you know, I don't drink and I don't smoke and I don't gamble. And, and, and, you know, I like to make jokes about things. And he says, well, what's the matter with you? I said, well, I just like to keep up my strength for a worthwhile vice. And, and, and, and yeah, but he came back pretty good. He says, well, it's too bad you're a weakling. He says, I got them all going. And so, yeah. So that was the end of that, you know. But, but, but, but yeah. If I had a failing, uh, in, in all of this, you know, it was that every now and then I, I, I, I, uh, my vision was focused on some woman's crotch.
Is that your, that's your vice?
Yeah. But, but other than that, you know, I try to keep it fairly straight.
Well, that's okay. And it's, you know, there's, there's a lot to be, you know, said for that.
Yeah, there's probably a lot that shouldn't be said.
